text: Meet Gusan, a keyboard for iPhone. A friend asks for help in WhatsApp.
Tap the chip to switch to Agent: an H Company computer-use agent that works in a real browser.
Tap the mic and just say it. Gusan listens, and the Dynamic Island glows.
Speech becomes text, and the strip shows what it heard.
The agent starts a read-only research task: it browses the web and reports back, and never buys or sends anything.
Progress lives in the Dynamic Island as a Live Activity: opening Leboncoin, comparing twelve listings.
Meanwhile, it is still your keyboard. Keep chatting while the agent works.
Result ready. The answer comes back into the chat you were in. Tap Insert.
Three listings with links, inserted at your cursor and ready to send.
Sent, and you never left the chat. No browser tab, no copy-paste.
Anna replies. Now a quick rewrite with Smart: no agent, no browser.
Type a rough reply, typos and all.
Select the draft. The selection is what gets replaced.
Switch the chip back to Smart.
Tap the mic and say: make it friendlier and shorter.
The selection is replaced, with one tap to undo.
Say it. Gusan does it. Gusan, with H Company.
